_help: EXPERIMENTAL: first guesses, not tested in every game. Tune them and send improvements. Trigger travel has zones 0 (rest) to 9 (fully pressed). Most Xbox games register a trigger press at about zone 1 (XInput threshold 30/255), so clicks and snaps are placed early to land when the game reacts. Modes: off | feedback {start 0-9, strength 1-8} | slope {start, end, start_strength, end_strength} | multi {strengths: 10 values 0-8} | weapon {start 2-7, end, strength} | bow {start 0-7, end, strength, snap} | vibration {start, amplitude 1-8, frequency Hz} | machine {start, end, amplitude_a 0-7, amplitude_b 0-7, frequency, period} | galloping {start, end, first_foot 0-6, second_foot, frequency}. A game uses a preset ('preset': 'name') and may override L2 or R2. Games with '_native_dualsense': true have their own effects: play those with Xbox mode off.

gun_semi._feel: L2 aim: light tension. R2: short pull, crisp click right when the shot fires

gun_heavy._feel: L2 aim: firm. R2: longer, heavy pull, then a hard break (shotgun, plasma cutter)

gun_auto._feel: L2 aim: light. R2: light resistance with a rapid-fire rattle

gun_heavy_auto._feel: R2: heavy machine gun, slow strong pulses

melee_swing._feel: R2 heavy attack: tension builds early, then snaps back like committing to a swing

melee_light._feel: R2 attack: short, light tap of resistance that releases quickly

melee_hits._feel: R2 attack: quick, solid click (blunt weapons, kicks)

charge_hold._feel: R2 held to charge: resistance grows the deeper you press

bow._feel: L2 aim: light. R2: string tension rising to the end

force_powers._feel: Both triggers: smooth resistance that grows, like pushing against a force

power_and_gun._feel: L2 power hand: crackling buzz. R2 gun: crisp click

flashlight_and_gun._feel: L2 aim / flashlight: steady tension. R2 gun: crisp click

racing._feel: L2 brake: progressive, gets firm. R2 throttle: light, even spring

driving_rough._feel: Racing feel plus a light rumble in the throttle (off-road, trucks)

light_all._feel: Both triggers a little heavier, works in any game

alan_wake_2._controls: L2 Aim / focus flashlight, R2 Fire

alan_wake_remastered._controls: L2 Aim / boost flashlight, R2 Fire

control_resonant._controls: Melee combat (trigger functions not checked yet)

dark_souls_3._controls: L2 Weapon art, R2 Strong attack

final_fantasy_7_rebirth._controls: Triggers used for shortcuts and menus

final_fantasy_7_remake._controls: Triggers used for shortcuts and menus

gta_v._controls: On foot L2 Aim / R2 Fire, in cars L2 Brake / R2 Gas

silent_hill_f_charge._controls: Silent Hill f, alternative: R2 resistance grows like a charged swing

skyrim._controls: L2 / R2 left and right hand; bows draw on R2

star_wars_jedi_fallen_order._controls: Force powers on the triggers (check in game)

star_wars_jedi_survivor._controls: Force powers on the triggers (check in game)
